nodes.label: The Register (The Method 1.6)
nodes.rationale: 1734 entries numbered 1 to 1892, printed in the order the work happened because 'a result is worth what its derivation is worth': the measurements as taken, the arguments as made, and the reversals kept beside the claims they overturned. This file is the source; the generator register_gen.py was retired at Build 9 because a generator that no longer reads the record cannot claim not to drift.

nodes.label: The Fixed Entry Form
nodes.rationale: Every entry has one form: a capitalised headline, then the body in italics, written at a fixed density and standing alone. Entry 1725 records how the form was reached; build.py recomputes it at press.

nodes.label: A Correction Never Replaces What It Corrects
nodes.rationale: Both states are kept and the correcting entry names the entry corrected, so the record of a mistake survives its repair: 'a register that tidied itself would be evidence of nothing.'

nodes.label: Genesis Block (Entries 1-94)
nodes.rationale: The founding chat and the first paper, The Lach Elemental Lattice, prepended as the record of where the work began.

nodes.label: Superseded Lambda-8 Successor Stretch (95-164)
nodes.rationale: Each superseded entry marks the later entry that supersedes it rather than being deleted.

nodes.label: Mature Record (165-1892)
nodes.rationale: 1,570 entries, the stretch from which the five compendia are distilled.

nodes.label: Entry Kinds Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Eight overlapping kinds counted by headline pattern, not a partition: finding 1381, measurement 507, correction 219, prior art 61, new protocol 24, withdrawal 37, fault of mine 16, open question 23. A body tag such as '(a measurement.)' overrides the pattern.

nodes.label: Load-Bearing Entries (715 cited)
nodes.rationale: An entry exists because something rests on it; citations are counted each time an entry names another, self-citation excluded. 21 entries are cited seven times or more, 1460 most at 21 times.

nodes.label: Four Kinds of Correction Resolution
nodes.rationale: A fault is only half an entry; what resolved it is the other half. The four: a published result, a measurement the work already held, an audit written after the fact, and the person's correction.

nodes.label: Grouped Fault Entries (203-354)
nodes.rationale: Thirty-two early fault entries are printed together after entry 361 under seven grouped headings, the one exception to chronological order, because what those entries share is a mechanism rather than a moment.

nodes.label: Lambda, the Admissible Lattice
nodes.rationale: Lambda = {(n, l, k) in Z^3 : 0 <= l <= n-1, 1 <= k <= 2(2l+1)}, bounded by the angular-momentum condition and the Pauli capacity. The axes are counts, not lengths, and are coupled, so distances are combinatorial and not metric. Bounded at 976 cells with E = 0.

nodes.label: Three-Axis Configuration Lattice (n, l, k)
nodes.rationale: What the conventional table conflates into one positional axis is separated into three: shell number n, subshell type l, valence electron count k. No new physics is introduced, only a change of coordinates.

nodes.label: Void / Reactive / Reserved Partition of Empty Space
nodes.rationale: Every unoccupied cell falls into exactly one regime: void (l >= n, the orbital cannot exist), reactive (k above Pauli capacity, read as transient overflow), reserved (valid yet empty). The table has no vocabulary for absence; the coordinate change supplies one.

nodes.label: Hydrogen at (1,0,1) as the Unique Minimum
nodes.rationale: Placed at genesis by a zero-point-energy argument as a reference choice, later proved to be the only cell below every other: a theorem about the structure rather than a convention imposed on it.

nodes.label: Occupied Cells Form an Order Ideal of Lambda
nodes.rationale: Downward closed without exception across all 118 cells: there are no gaps beneath any occupied cell. Recorded as a property that does not appear to have been noted.

nodes.label: Chemical Groups as Fibres of Lambda
nodes.rationale: Fix (l, k) and vary n: each fibre is a line parallel to the n-axis whose elements are precisely a conventional chemical group, so the table's columns are one-dimensional fibres of a three-dimensional lattice.

nodes.label: Kainosymmetric Subshells on the Boundary Diagonal l = n-1
nodes.rationale: 1s, 2p, 3d, 4f and 5g: the subshells first of their kind, exactly the cells where the angular-momentum constraint is tight.

nodes.label: The Lambda Tower (Lambda-8 to Lambda-13)
nodes.rationale: Stages of the index built by adding coordinates; E = 0 at every stage with fill falling monotonically from 14.12% to 0.42%. Lambda-13 holds 199,130 cells.

nodes.label: Tower Composability Peaks at Lambda-10
nodes.rationale: Measured stage by stage: Lambda-8 0.0000, Lambda-9 0.7068, Lambda-10 0.8087, then falling to 0.6186 at Lambda-13. Lambda-8 composes at nothing because its source carries four coordinates against a target's three; the prediction under test was 100% and it turns at 80.87%.

nodes.label: Counting / Coupling Dichotomy
nodes.rationale: Counting axes raise composability and coupling axes lower it every time, with no exception: a counting axis says how much is present and a target can hand that to a source, while a coupling axis says how two momenta are oriented and an orientation belongs to a pair rather than to an end.

nodes.label: Composition Seen From Above Is a Bracket, Not a Map
nodes.rationale: The rank below a cell is not a function of the rank above: fibres branch 4, 4, 6, 8, 9 with height, yet every fibre is a gap-free monotone interval across all 199,130 cells of Lambda-13, so the connection between the tower's two ends carries at full resolution.

nodes.label: The Cypher Analysis and the Five Operator-Bearing Languages
nodes.rationale: An index read in several languages (order, algebra, geometry, information, statistics) each returning a cell decision, with E(X) the defect count. Testing closure on an inadmissible axis invites register 1287's fault, so candidates are admitted or refused before closure is tested.

nodes.label: E(X) = 0 If and Only If the Languages Agree
nodes.rationale: Stated over six indexes and three operators without exception; the cheaper test, since pairwise consistency needs only the marginals. The 'only if' half later meets a counterexample in the book's own mathematical objects, where five languages agree and E = 2.

nodes.label: The Method Equation (R and W halves)
nodes.rationale: Both halves measured on an index: R places cells and reports E, W reports E_W. Applied to Lambda_spectra the metric half is empty, because every measured scatter exceeds the step.

nodes.label: Staircase / Connected Row-Convex Closure
nodes.rationale: c <= Z makes the admitted set a staircase, and a staircase is exactly the E = 0 condition; admission and closure are questions in different languages, so a determined axis need not be a closing one.

nodes.label: The Rank-One Constraint Certificate
nodes.rationale: Every one of six constraint vectors is a positive multiple of (4, 1), so the constraint matrix has rank one and all half-planes are bounded by parallel lines through the origin with three pointing each way. Parallel-with-both-signs is infeasible by inspection, so the ratio-4 identity does not lead to the proof, it IS the proof.

nodes.label: The Corridor Instrument
nodes.rationale: Posit a form, require the observed order; each rival gives one linear inequality on the free parameter, so each object confines it to an interval. An empty feasible set refutes the form and a non-empty one does NOT confirm it - an asymmetry the work read as confirmation for a hundred and fifty registers. The corridor tests a form, not a magnitude.

nodes.label: The nu Law, Deactivated and Retained as the Atomic Form
nodes.rationale: Reclassified from THE LOWDIN SOLUTION to THE ATOMIC FORM, the first form the corridor was applied to; nothing is deleted. The move is cheap because the two objects were never one - five entries state or use nu and forty-six use the corridor, and the corridor's sharpest result used Nilsson's form, not nu.

nodes.label: The Lowdin Challenge
nodes.rationale: Asks for the index to be populated without spectral observation. On that question the work's standing is 90 of 106 against a null of 96, and it should be quoted that way until it is not.

nodes.label: Madelung / n+l Filling Rule
nodes.rationale: Takes no free parameter and scores 96 of 106 out of sample. Deriving n+l exactly would derive something false at two elements - 5d before 4f and 6d before 5f - so the work derives the order nu names rather than the name that is 89 per cent accurate.

nodes.label: The Janet Block as an Axis
nodes.rationale: Explains 87% of within-l variance of delta against a 5.5% null and delta rises monotonically with block at every l - a re-coordinatisation, not a join. Admitted on the statistics face, yet the proposed (block, l, charge) index does not close.

nodes.label: The Quantum Defect delta
nodes.rationale: Per channel, derivable from the ground state rather than the sample. delta mod 1 is the Schrodinger observable and the integer part is assigned convention, the solution depending only on cos(pi delta) and sin(pi delta).

nodes.label: Lambda_spectra, the Spectra Index
nodes.rationale: Rydberg series are unbounded in n and l runs to n-1, so the spectra index is infinite unless capped, and every cap is a decision - including l <= 7, which is not a physical bound but the highest l anyone has measured.

nodes.label: Maximality Is Bracketed by Observability
nodes.rationale: Space and time are the two columns and not indices; an observer's register is Lambda-valued because observation IS an atomic state change. The atomic walk terminates, so the observability register has a finite supply of cells and maximality can be asserted only as far as that supply reaches - a bracket rather than an assumption.

nodes.label: WITNESSED / UNWITNESSED / BOUND
nodes.rationale: Replaces the IMPROBABLE status axis with a fact and a reason, so counts can distinguish the record from the theory. 337 cells of 101,328 are witnessed, 0.333 per cent; nothing is lost because every old reason survives as a bound, and what is lost is the claim to know which obstacles will be overcome.

nodes.label: The Pauli Bound B on the Integer Part of delta
nodes.rationale: floor(delta) <= B at 311 of 311 channels and equals B exactly at 57 per cent, while delta itself exceeds B at 176 of 311 and violates nothing. The integer part is nearly determined and the fraction, where the physics is, is not predicted at all.

nodes.label: An Index Mixing Object with Observer Cannot Close
nodes.rationale: With attributed, derived, measured and fitted on an axis the constant index closes at no ordering. The same fault recurs five times - origin in Lambda_var, kind in Lambda_phys, state in Lambda_ladder, and IMPROBABLE - and measurement confirms it: the witness flag explains exactly 0.0 per cent, so an observer fact must stay a column and never become an axis.

nodes.label: A Check That Cannot Fail
nodes.rationale: A check that admits inputs incapable of failing it reports a pass rate higher than its own discriminating power; a test that cannot fail returns no failures, and that is indistinguishable from success. Sightings include J-pairs that cannot differ, two-member channels that cannot detect perturbation, and a bracket equal to an interior.

nodes.label: Audits Check Consistency, Not Provenance
nodes.rationale: A column always equal to another column satisfies every cross-check and tests nothing, so the fault was invisible to every audit: the compendium audit confirmed sums matched and the artefact audit confirmed the render matched the source.

nodes.label: The Bootstrap Fault in Parameter Placement
nodes.rationale: a is fixed by the entrant's corridor and the entrant is what a determines, so the placement confirms whatever it was given. Carrying a across species hid the loop by importing the value from elsewhere; per-atom calibration is right and makes it visible.

nodes.label: The Recitation Fault
nodes.rationale: Composing the register entry and the computation in one step lets the text precede the result: tier and cell counts were written as predictions before the instrument ran. Remedy - entries that cite instrument output are written only after the output is in hand, compute and register in separate steps.

nodes.label: The Fetch Cache Rule and Its Retraction
nodes.rationale: Recorded as one response per host and path whatever is asked, so what breaks it is a URL the person pastes in; corrected at register 1629, where there is no cache at all - only one ie.pl URL had ever appeared in a search result. The observation stands and the cause was wrong.

nodes.label: A Blank Field Is Data
nodes.rationale: Writing anything into a blank field is fabrication however plausible the source of the number; and a spot-check that samples only well-formed rows cannot see a fault in the malformed ones, so a check must target the rows that differ from the rest.

nodes.label: Uniform Failure Is a Fault in the Instrument
nodes.rationale: New protocol earned by register 1718: when a check fails identically across every case of a variable the object depends on, the fault is upstream of the object.

nodes.label: The Main Volume (chapters and appendices)
nodes.rationale: 412 entries are cited in the main volume's chapters and appendices; 884 counting the four compendia and the two papers; 1,116 counting citations by other entries.

nodes.label: M, the Person (the author)
nodes.rationale: One of the four resolution kinds is the person's correction - pushing back where the assistant stopped looking too early. M supplies URLs that break the fetch cache, issues rulings, and sets standing protocols such as 'every null is a mathematical gap that may require a different mathematical language to fill it'.

nodes.label: register_gen.py (retired at Build 9)
nodes.rationale: Retired because entries from 1701 on and the settled form of every entry were entered by hand, and a generator that no longer reads the record cannot claim not to drift.

nodes.label: contingency.py
nodes.rationale: Exists in the tree to catch a self-consistency test that cannot fail, and was not run on the author's own construction.

nodes.label: N-8, the Resolvent Norm
nodes.rationale: The product over the eight sign choices, replacing a withdrawn degree-8 polynomial whose quartic term was 2p^2 + 16q against the true 6p^2 - 8q. Prior art: Lagrange's resolvent method, so not new mathematics.

nodes.label: RULING 23 - the Monotonicity Caption
nodes.rationale: Neither a bare retention nor an exclusion of the crossing channels but the statement of what is true: the fall is monotone wherever the defect is the core's, and the three rises are named and marked.

nodes.label: RULING 24 - Section 34.4 Is the Canonical Statement of the Rule
nodes.rationale: The Lowdin chapter was never formalised before the project began, so the section is original and its best wording is the builder's to provide; the body now gives the rule, what it is, its derivation, its attribution and its function in the solution.

nodes.label: RULING 25 - A Surviving Claim Defined
nodes.rationale: Four clauses define a surviving claim; the census gives 369 surviving against 1,555 withdrawn, a ratio of 4.21:1, p(survive) 0.192, 0.705 bits - a measured property of the book rather than a range.

nodes.label: RULING 26 - the Sealed-Test Ruling on the 489 Untested Rows
nodes.rationale: Strict interval membership, the quotation floor as the only epsilon, section 22.5 admissibility; a cell whose measurement cannot distinguish pass from fail is refused rather than passed with slack. The 2-sigma tolerance option is rejected as an inferential sigma grafted onto a deductive bracket - the fault species of a check that cannot fail.

nodes.label: Lowdin 1969 (the demand for a derivation of n+l)
Deville, Barette & Van Hentenryck 1999 (connected row-convex constraints)
nodes.rationale: Cited sixteen times with Barette and six times with Bartak, who is a different worker in the same field; three independent published reference lists settle the second author as Barette, O. A majority of citations is not a fact about a name.

nodes.rationale: theta_ab = 0 is invariant under the residual rescaling of the affine parameter, and a condition invariant under a group cannot fix that group's parameter.

nodes.label: Register 1139 - Channel Multiplicity Is Derivable From the Ground State
Register 1176 - the Cypher Returns a Theorem-Shaped Result
Register 1287 - the Constant Index and Its Refused Axis
Register 1306 - the Observed Ground Configurations, Read Not Computed
Register 1445 - the 99 Was Fitted, Not Generated
Register 1448 - the Per-Atom Fixed Point Is Vacuous
Register 1459 - delta on a Monotone (l, Block) Grid
Register 1460 - nu Deactivated as a Law, Retained as a Form
Register 1462 - the Ratio-4 Identity Is the Proof
Register 1526 - Four Fabricated Theory Values Caught by a Second Capture
Register 1578 - IMPROBABLE Removed From the Index
Register 1581 - Six Candidate Axes Tested, Z Refused at 2.1%
Register 1595 - the Address Is Not the Scarce Thing, the Cache-Miss Is

Register 1664 - 145 of 554 Computed Against the Wrong Core
nodes.rationale: The 145 are voided with the reason named, not deleted: the measurement stays and the false value does not stand. The fallback rule 'else the first limit above its top member' is the silent default section 2.9 forbids.

nodes.label: Register 1704 - No g Block Below Z = 121
nodes.rationale: Every g channel sits at -1/(2n^2) to storage precision over a hundred protons while every s/p/d/f channel moves with Z: a relation the data cannot violate is defending something, and the null response is the theorem.

nodes.label: Register 1725 - How the Entry Form Was Reached
Register 1736 - Ten Bibliography Rows That Were Not Works
Register 1880 - the Tower's Two Ends Joined by a Bracket
Register 1881 - a Counterexample to the Agreement Theorem's Only-If Half
nodes.rationale: Seventy-seven mathematical objects graded on (status, verification, precedent) hold 11 cells of a 16-cell box, all five operator-bearing languages admit the same 13, and E = 2 - so languages can agree where the index does not close. The 'if' half is untouched.

nodes.label: Register 1886 - the kappa Apparatus Withdrawn, Five Entries Fall
nodes.rationale: The +0.980 correlation tracked one algorithm's failure mode, not the seed: twelve cycles of fitting to a single algorithm's output, every fit confirmed against numbers from that same source, caught only when the definition forced a different algorithm to be written. What survives is named so the withdrawal is not read as a demolition.

nodes.label: Register 1890 - One Paper Cited Under Two Different Second Authors
Register 1891 - Six Bibliography Rows Naming No Work
nodes.rationale: Generated rows pair the last name of one field with the first parenthesised year of the next. No removal loses a pointer, and that was established before any row moved; the count is restated with both prior counts kept beside it.

nodes.label: Register 1892 - the Owed Expansion Was Already Printed
nodes.rationale: The object is named for its result rather than its mechanism, so a search keyed to mechanism words answered to none of them: a search narrower than the material returns the absence it was shaped to find.
